fields.insights_description: Veronica Siehl has a diverse work experience in the field of UX and Product Design. Veronica is currently a Senior Product Design at Crafty since May 2022. Prior to that, she worked as a Product Designer at Alight Solutions dedicated to Wealth team projects. Veronica also worked as a Senior Product Designer at Alight dedicated to the Worklife Platform initiative team. Alight is a cloud-based human capital technology and services provider that powers confident health, wealth and wellbeing decisions for 36 million people and dependents. At Flatiron School Veronica served as a Supporting Instructor for UX/UI Design. Veronica started her career in Tech as an Implementation Expert at Jellyvision in 2017. In her previous career, Veronica held roles of Studio Manager and Teaching Artist in the arts not-for-profit space from 2013 to 2019. Veronica Siehl attended Beloit College where she was a Studio Arts major and received her Bachelor of Arts degree in 2006. She later attended University of Tennessee where she received her Master of Fine Arts in Printmaking in 2010.

fields.insights_description: Daniel Slesnick has worked in the recruiting and account management fields since 2012. Their work experience includes roles at BCKSTGR, Robert Half Technology, JW Michaels & Co., Meta, Apple, and Atlis Motor Vehicles. At BCKSTGR, Slesnick served as an Account Manager, developing activities to engage and reward consumers for digital, physical, and/or transactional interaction with brands. At Robert Half Technology, they were an Account Executive, identifying and closing sales opportunities. At JW Michaels & Co., Slesnick was a Senior Technical Recruiter, partnering with hiring managers to strategize on best recruitment practices. At Meta, they were a Technical Sourcer for Software Engineering, working closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand technical requirements. At Apple, Slesnick was a Technical Recruiter, building teams that build products. Finally, at Atlis Motor Vehicles, they were the Director of Recruiting/ Sr. Recruiter, increasing the size of the company from 27 employees to over 90 in under 12 months, migrating the company to a new ATS, and implementing interview and hiring standards. Daniel Slesnick attended Libertyville High School before obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Arts, Entertainment, and Media Management from Columbia College Chicago in 2012.

fields.insights_description: Josh Sherlock is an experienced IT professional with a strong background in technology management and operations. Currently serving as the Director of IT Daily Operations & User Support at Invenergy LLC since October 2019, Josh leads a team focused on improving IT services and support. Previously, as the Manager of IT Service Desk and Desktop Engineering at Grubhub, responsibilities included overseeing a large team to ensure business continuity through IT projects. Prior experience includes serving as Information Technology Director at The SAVO Group, where Josh managed all aspects of IT and set corporate technology direction, and IT Manager at Inforte / Business & Decision, managing IT operations and a team of three. Early career roles involved critical technical support and administration for companies such as Accenture and SDRC, providing experience with large-scale IT systems. Josh holds a B.S. in Political Science from Michigan State University.
